changes: Closed the current convergence high gaps by adding machine-visible implementation mappings for Autopilot provider-health events, done-closure local assurance vocabulary, and ProofStory key/source requirement binding. Also corrected the new annotations so active source no longer trips the retired vocabulary guard.
usage: Run lattice gap_analyze --json and lattice convergence_check --json from the Proofbound worktree to verify the high-gap and annotation state. The story itself is managed through the normal Proofbound lifecycle and does not add a user-facing CLI command.
expectedOutcome: Current convergence state should report zero high-priority gaps, code annotations should be compliant, retired server-backed completion vocabulary should not be reintroduced in active annotations, and stale B-fbb6 work should not be merged.
actualTranscript: TEST evidence: lattice validate --story=B-3b99 --json returned status=pass, allPass=true, verification coverage 13/13, missingRequired=0. done_required_validate passed packages/main build and root npm test. gap_analyze reports 0 high / 1 medium. convergence_check passes No high-priority gaps, Flow chain complete, Code annotations compliant, Parked backlog, Audit backlog, and Requirements coverage; before DONE it only reports B-3b99 as unfinished.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match for the requested high-gap closure. The remaining medium gap is an existing missing fixture reference outside this story scope, and the all-stories convergence row is expected to clear only after B-3b99 reaches DONE.
limitations: The story closes current high-priority convergence gaps only. It does not resolve the pre-existing medium missing fixture gap and does not merge or revive stale B-fbb6 branch work.
pitfalls: Do not treat dev-memory as gate evidence. Do not reintroduce retired server-backed completion vocabulary in active annotations just to satisfy gap text. Future mapping closures should prefer current local assurance terminology and verify with the retired vocabulary guard.
